Step 6 also appears to show black pieces near the front of the ground-level yellow plates. I could not identify them and left them out.

Sub-step 2: I read the two dark grey pieces as 2x2 plates and the sloped one as a dark grey 45° 2x2 brick (lego-3039). I read the small yellow upright piece as a yellow 1x1 brick, but this is uncertain. The slope's exact support is also uncertain.

On page 5 and 6 I recorded some colours from the pictures (yellow 3795, grey 3666). The remaining-parts list on this page seems to have been decremented as if I had used the black 3795 and red 3666 instead. The colours I recorded match what the pictures show.
Page 8 restarts step numbering at 1 and builds a new sub-assembly that is not yet attached to the earlier model, so b28 and b29 have empty rests_on.

Page 16 starts bag 2, the truck cab. Step 1 is a black Technic brick 1x16.

Step 2: I read the red piece as a Brick Special 2x2 with Pin and Axle Hole (lego-6232). Its pin goes through one hole of the beam. A black Technic pin (lego-2780) goes through another hole and into its axle hole. I assumed the red brick sits behind the beam. Because it attaches sideways, rests_on is empty.

Sub-steps 1-2: the dark grey part is the Technic cannon launcher (lego-57796, complete assembly). Its top plug is part of that piece. Two black Technic pins, marked with the blue 4 callout, go through its lower pin holes. I read the pins as lego-2780.

Step 3: the cannon is attached to the side of the first Technic brick 1x16 b82 using the pins. Step 4: a second black Technic brick 1x16 (b88) goes on the other side, so the cannon is held between the two beams. The picture does not show the second beam's connection, so the pin joins are my reading.
The white crosses on the second beam in step 4 and the rotation symbols in step 3 mark holes and rotations that matter in later steps. I recorded nothing for them.

Step 5: a second red 2x2 pin brick (lego-6232) is attached to the second beam b88 with another black pin, mirroring step 2. Red plates are laid along the tops of the two beams: a red 1x6 plate on each, and a red Technic 2x4 plate bridging both beams at the right end. The red layout is hard to read, so these identifications are a best guess.

Step 6 turns the assembly over (cyan rotate icon). A black Technic plate 2x8 (lego-3738) goes crosswise across the two beams, on their underside, with the pins showing at its ends. The crossbeam could also be a different black piece.
Rests_on for b93 and b94 assumes the beams b82 and b88 sit side by side with a gap between them.
Sub-steps 1-5 build a front sub-assembly. It is added to the beam assembly in step 7.

Sub-step 1: red 4x6 plate. Sub-step 2: two black 1x3 plates lie under the left edge of the red plate. Each overlaps the red plate by one stud and sticks out with two exposed studs. The red plate was added first, so b96 and b97 have empty rests_on and the overlap is recorded as joins.
Sub-steps 3-4: a red right wedge plate 4x2 and a red left wedge plate 4x2 go on the two sides of the left edge. A dark grey 2x2 plate is also placed on the red plate.
Sub-step 5: the red pieces on top are read as a red 2x2 brick, a red 1x2 brick and a red 2x2 grooved tile. This reading is uncertain.
Step 7: the sub-assembly attaches to the left end of the beam assembly, which was flipped back over. I recorded a join to the crossbeam b94 as a guess.

Step 8: the 1:1, 3x callout shows an axle with a black round hub on it. It carries a size marker of 10, so I read it as a Technic axle 10 (lego-3737) with a black Round Brick 2x2 with Axle Hole (lego-3941) at one end. Three of these axles go crosswise through the beams.

The remaining-parts list showed only two lego-3737 left before this page. I recorded three axles because the 3x callout needs three. The extra axle is a count mismatch with my earlier axle guesses on pages 14-15.
Step 9 puts a black round brick on the opposite end of each of the three axles. They are the wheel hubs for the truck cab's three axles.

Step 10: a sub-assembly built 2x. A dark grey 1x2 pin brick (lego-2458) sits on a black 1x2 plate. Each copy goes onto one of the red 1x6 plates beside the cannon, with its pin pointing sideways. I assumed b113 goes on b91 and b115 on b92.

Step 11: a red Technic beam 1x7 gets a light grey half pin in sub-step 2. Sub-step 3 shows the beam from the side with a red flat strip along it. I read the strip as a red 1x8 tile (lego-4162). This is a guess because it is unclear how it attaches. The beam is then pushed onto the pins of the two pin bricks, with the half pin sticking out for a later step.

Sub-steps 1-4 build a small rear pivot sub-assembly: a white axle-and-pin connector with two Technic axle 4s through it, two thin Technic beams 1x3 on the axles, and two black sloped pieces at the ends. Step 12 puts it on the rear of the chassis.

I read the two black sloped pieces as Technic slope long 1x6 (lego-2744). The remaining list showed only one left before this page, so the count does not fit. They might be a different black slope part. The white crosses on them mark axle holes.
Step 12: I assumed the sloped pieces sit on the red Technic plate b93 at the rear end. This is a guess because the connection is not clear.
Step 13: a black 1x2 grille tile (lego-2412b) goes on the top studs of the left black slope b125 of the rear pivot sub-assembly.

Step 14 sub-assembly, built 2x: a red bracket 1x2-2x2 (lego-44728) with a black 1x2 grille tile pressed onto its vertical face. One copy goes on the red pin brick b83 and the other on b89, one on each side of the cannon. Which stud each copy clutches is a guess.
Step 14 may also show dark grey pieces over the cannon area. I could not tell what they are, so they are not recorded.
Step 15: two black 2x2 seats (lego-4079b) go on top of the two red brackets with grille tiles, one on each side of the cannon.

Step 16: I read the light grey perforated piece laid on the red front plate as a Technic plate 2x6 (lego-32001). I read the black round part being pushed on from the left (green arrow) as a black Round Brick 2x2 with Axle Hole (lego-3941). I could not confirm either identification. How the round brick attaches is also unclear.

Step 17: a callout shows two stacked black 1x6 bricks, built 2x. That gives four black 1x6 bricks, two stacks, laid along the left half of the chassis over the cannon. I assumed each stack sits on one of the two beams, b82 and b88.

Step 18 sub-steps: a dark grey 6x6 plate is framed by red plates. I read the frame as two red 1x6 plates for the long sides and two red 1x4 plates for the short sides. Sub-step 3 adds one more red 1x4 plate inside the right edge, which I inferred from the narrower opening. This roof or floor sub-assembly is then put on top of the two black stacks, so b140 rests on b137 and b139.

Step 20 sub-assembly, built 2x: a red bracket 1x2-2x2 (lego-44728) goes on top of each headlight stack. The bracket's vertical face faces forward as a grille or bumper piece.

There are two arches in the parts list, but only the near-side one is visible, so I recorded one. The far-side arch is probably added in a later view.
Step 22: a black piece appears at the back of the roof platform. I read it as the black 2x4 plate (lego-3020), but it is partly hidden by the seat and this is uncertain. Its support is also a guess.

Step 23: a red 1x4 plate is placed on the red edge row of the roof platform (b141), where the two green arrows point. The red lever base (lego-298c02, with its black lever) is shown in the callout and goes onto the black plate b157 between the two seats.

Step 25: two black 1x3 plates appear on the roof platform, one at the back-left and one nearer the seats. I read them as lego-3623 (the black 1x3 plates in the remaining list). Their exact supports are guesses.

Sub-step 3 adds a red curved wedge with 4 studs (lego-52031), which forms the sloped grille face. In sub-step 4, sticker 12 is applied to that face.
I assumed the wedge in sub-step 3 sits on the red plate, so b168 rests_on b166. How it fits over the plate and the clips is not fully visible.

Step 29: the grille is attached to the front of the cab. The picture shows only that it goes between the headlight brackets and against the front of the roof. The joins to b163, b154 and b155 are my reading of that.

Sub-steps 1-7 build the red rear roof (sleeper roof). It starts from a light grey 2x4 plate with pins (lego-30157). I read sub-step 2 as two red 1x6 plates side by side on top of it. Sub-step 3 adds two red 1x2 plates at the sides. Sub-step 5 adds the last red curved wedge (lego-52031), forming the sloped top. Sub-step 6 adds two red 1x4 plates on the wedge studs. This layer-by-layer reading is a best guess because the pieces overlap heavily.
Sub-step 7 appears to show a raised back edge or visor on the roof. I could not identify that piece, so it is not recorded.
Step 30: the roof goes onto the back of the cab and its pins push into the upright red Technic beam (b117).

Step 31: a mirror of the page 21 sub-assembly. A red Technic beam 1x7 gets a light grey half pin and a red 1x8 tile, and goes on as the right-hand upright of the cab. I assumed it fits onto the second pin of the roof's pin plate. The same attachment uncertainty applies to the tile.

Step 32: six black wheels (lego-56145) with six black tyres (lego-55978) are fitted to the three axle hubs, two per axle. The parts list has 8 of each, so two sets are left for later. I assumed each wheel presses onto a black round brick hub (b107-b112). The front axle carries b107 and b110, the middle axle b108 and b111, and the rear axle b109 and b112.

Step 7: a second black Technic brick 1x16 is pushed onto the pins that stick out the back of the dark grey Technic bricks. Two arrows show two pins. I assumed they are b201 and b204.

Step 10: a black Technic plate 2x8 (lego-3738) is placed on the beams next to the large 6x8 plate, extending the flat deck toward the front end. The deck in the picture looks slightly longer than one 6x8 plate plus a 2x8 plate. I may have missed a second plate, but the remaining list shows three 6x8 plates left and none placed here, so I recorded none.
Step 11: the deck is longer. A black 6x8 plate (lego-3036) is added at the far end, covering the two long beams, so I recorded one more plate.

Step 12: a sub-assembly built 2x. A red 1x2 plate sits on a light grey 1x4 plate (callout), and both copies go onto the middle of the deck. Beyond the callout, step 12 shows a red 1x2 brick at the back-right and a red 1x2 plate at the front-right of the deck. I read them as pieces added in this step. The 1x2 brick may also be a 2x2 brick seen from an angle.

Step 13: a red strip runs along the front edge of the deck, in three segments. I read it as three red 1x8 tiles (lego-4162). Two red corner blocks with four studs sit at the left end. I read these as a red 2x2 brick (lego-3003) and a red 2x3 brick (lego-3002). The 2x3 reading is uncertain, because the block shows only a 2x2 stud pattern.

Step 14: a wall of four reddish-brown palisade logs (lego-30137) alternating with three dark grey 1x2 bricks is built along the back edge of the deck. It ends at the red 1x2 brick b218. The supports for each wall piece are my best guesses from its position along the deck.

Step 15: three white 1x4x3 panels (lego-4215b) are set on the back wall of the deck, one on the left and two side by side on the right. A tower of red 1x2 bricks is built on the red brick b218 at the back-right. I read three red 1x2 bricks added in this step, the last one shown with arrows. A tall red 75° slope (lego-4460b) stands on the red plate b219 at the front-right end. Which wall pieces each panel rests on is a guess.
Step 16: stickers 1, 2 and 3 are the green poster decals on the three white panels. I recorded them as joins from the sticker sheet b51.

Step 17: two red 75° slopes (lego-3684) go on the two red corner bricks at the left end of the deck. I assumed b239 goes on b223 and b240 on b224. A callout shows a black turntable base with a light grey turntable top pressed onto it. The assembled turntable sits at the middle of the deck.

Step 18 sub-assembly: a light grey 2x6 platform, which I read as two light grey 1x6 plates side by side. Two light grey sloped bricks (lego-3039) sit on it, making a console. Stickers 10 and 11 are the screen and control-panel decals on the slopes. I assumed one slope is light grey and one dark grey, since both remain in the parts list. The console goes on the red 1x2 plates in the middle of the deck.
The colour of the second slope is uncertain, because the picture shows both slopes the same light grey.

Step 19: the trailer gets a red top frame. I read the long row of red studs along the back as two red 1x10 plates (lego-4477) resting on the white panels and the red brick tower. A red 1x2 plate (callout) is added at the left end, on the two red slopes. The picture shows the frame rails but not exactly how they are supported, so rests_on is a best guess.

Step 20: the frame studs are covered with red tiles. I read two red 1x8 tiles (lego-4162) and three red 1x6 tiles (lego-6636). The tiles go along the back rail, the left end and the right end where the frame meets the right slope. Their exact lengths and positions are uncertain.

Sub-steps 1-5 build an aquarium on a black 2x4 brick with a black 2x6 plate on top. Two clear 1x4x3 panels (lego-4215b) stand on the plate, one in front and one behind, with the fish sticker (4) on the front panel. A light grey 1x6 tile caps them.

The picture shows a black 2x4 brick and a black 2x6 plate here. The remaining list shows no black ones, because the tracker took earlier colours in the wrong order. I used the black part types anyway, since that is what the picture shows.
Step 21: the aquarium is placed at the left end of the deck. I assumed it rests on the deck plate b213.

Step 22: a black Technic axle connector (lego-59443) is put on the end of the dark grey 5.5 axle with stop (lego-59426). This joystick or camera arm is pushed into the middle of the console. Exactly where it fits is not clear from the picture.
Step 23: the reddish brown 2x2 seat (lego-4079b) goes on the turntable top b242 in front of the console.

I read the axle as a black Technic axle 4, but it is drawn grey and could be a different axle. Its support is also a guess.

Several parts in the official list were never placed, because I could not identify them in the step pictures. They include the projectile (lego-57028c01), both steering stands (lego-3829c01), the clip plates (lego-6019), the 2x2 corner plates (lego-2420), the red 1x6 tiles and the second red arch (lego-50967). The remaining-parts tracker also drifted from the pictures on colours, so some part counts could not be checked.

Many placements, supports and joins were guesses from small isometric pictures. In particular, support relations in the truck cab and trailer sub-assemblies (pages 19-48) are best readings, and the tracker's remaining-parts list was only a rough check.

This delta only adds the 80 parts that were in the official list but never placed in my first pass. I placed them on the nearest plausible existing piece of the right model: Racer X (b16, b37, b49, b50, b56, b62), the truck cab (b95, b140, b157, b163) or the trailer (b206-b213, b256).

I cannot remove b64 and b65 in an additions-only delta, so the graph keeps them and they should be read as duplicates of b350 and b351.
